Title: Context Pack Test Fixture Root
Content: Purpose-built root memory for deterministic MemorySmith integration tests. The unique quartzwave marker should make lexical, semantic, and hybrid retrieval easy to target. This root references one child fixture, conflicts with one contrary fixture, and is referenced by a backlink fixture so memorysmith_context_pack can verify explicit ids, reference expansion, conflict expansion, includeBacklinks, maxRecords, and format=json behavior against stable project-wiki data.

SourceLinks.Label: Fixture graph behavior in base tests
